description: This file defines a configuration class for integrating the CometAPI embedding service into a larger system. It provides methods for constructing API URLs, validating environments, mapping parameters, transforming requests and responses, and handling errors. The class is designed to be compatible with OpenAI's embedding API standards while accommodating CometAPI-specific details.

classes.description: Configuration class for CometAPI Embedding API, supporting URL construction, environment validation, parameter mapping, request/response transformation, and error handling.
